matching_action: Compare current description, accepted source and dependencies; reuse/extend only exact matching scope, otherwise propose a linked missing-scope task. Preserve original estimates, actuals and historical evidence; record native readback before admitted effects.

payload.title: Wire owner direction, questions and writer outboxes
payload.goal: The operator acknowledges precise owner revisions, asks once and resumes the correct blocked work.
payload.owner_role: OPO dedicated Windows release owner / admitted implementation lane
implementation_steps: Consume authenticated mission direction revisions, acknowledge source/revision actually used and cancel queued effects when pause or changed limits apply. Example: pause paid services and prioritize free format conversion while public messages continue.

Bind existing hostname question and future needs_input to one ID/responder/resource; validate supplied resource scope, preserve prior answers and resume only affected preconditions. No asking for secret values.

Emit immutable experiment-before-action, outcome and review outboxes keyed to dedicated OPO writer; require native source/scope/readback receipt before registered experiment actions, reconcile writer outage or duplicate response.
tests: Replay owner message gives one acknowledgement; pause received after decision but before effect prevents that effect.
A WHB response or untrusted visitor cannot answer OPO hostname authority; a validated owner revision resumes exactly the dependent job once.
Writer outage preserves outbox, blocks unregistered experiment action, and permits independent engineering/observation.

review.identity_requirement: A reviewer other than the implementer records actual identity, model/effort and host; distinct-model review when required by the admitted contract. Self-review does not qualify.
review.source_binding: Review exact Git commit and SHA256 manifest of changed source/assets/config; distinguish Windows CRLF worktree bytes from Git blobs. Any repair invalidates affected prior approval.
review.bounded_repairs: At most two repair/review attempts per candidate within admitted budget; unresolved failure creates one actionable block and leaves independent work eligible.

acceptance: Direction and missing-input handling survive restart without question spam or authority confusion.
OPO proposals never use the combined parent as a competing issue writer.
payload.rollback: Disable this capability, retain immutable evidence/receipts, restore the last reviewed source/config version and reconcile attempted external effects before any retry.
payload.next_eligible_action: Designated owner matches the proposed scope to current Jira/source and assigns disjoint paths; then perform implementation step 1. External gates block only the named effects.

estimate.assumptions: New planning estimate, not historical estimate or worklog. Reuse accepted returned implementation where its exact source passes this contract. Excludes elapsed observation windows, account waiting and shared SH implementation.
estimate.dependency_risk: Host/provider/account qualification or conflicting release-worker ownership can delay dependent effects; offline work remains eligible.
